title: Today's training
lede: About 20 minutes: your own mistakes on spaced repetition, plus puzzles near your rating. Most items ask the key question: after this move, what does your opponent do?

home.doneToday: Done for today. Come back tomorrow — repetition only works if it is spaced.
home.bankMissing: The puzzle bank is not installed yet, so sessions only use positions from your games. Run: npm run puzzles:import -- --file lichess_db_puzzle.csv.zst
home.bankFixture: Using the small sample puzzle set.
home.reviewsPending_one: {{count}} recent game is waiting for review
home.reviewsPending_other: {{count}} recent games are waiting for review
home.syncDone: Games fetched. Analysis runs in the background.
home.syncFailed: Could not fetch games right now.

session.refutationPrompt: Candidate move: {{move}}. What is the strongest reply? Play it.
session.refutationHint: You are moving the opponent's pieces. Look for checks, captures and threats.
session.findPrompt: {{color}} to move. Find the best move.
session.findPromptOwn: From your game (move {{n}}). Find a better move than the one you played.
session.refutationOwn: From your game (move {{n}}): you played {{move}}. How did your opponent punish it?
session.continue: Right — the reply was {{move}}. Keep going.
session.correctAlt: Good: the engine accepts your move too.
session.unverified: The engine could not verify this move, so it does not count.
session.summaryHint: Missed positions come back tomorrow. Solid ones return in a few days.
session.overTime: Time is up for today; finish this item and stop.
session.empty: Nothing to train yet: import games or install the puzzle bank.

explain.ai: Explanation (AI, checked against the engine lines)
explain.fork: After it, these are attacked at once: {{list}}.
explain.material: Material lost in this line: {{count}} points.
explain.habit: Habit: before you move, list your opponent's checks, captures and threats after your move.

status.no_credentials: AI explanations are off: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to enable them.
status.rejected: The AI text mentioned an unverified move, so only the checked summary is shown.
status.refused: No AI explanation for this position.
status.rate_limited: AI explanations are busy; try again in a minute.

review.title: Game review
review.lede: Three minutes after each game: the three costliest moments, and what you saw before the engine tells you.
review.empty: No analysed games yet. Fetch your latest games first.
review.askTry: Before the engine: what would you play here now? Make your move on the board.

causes.not_seen: I didn't see the opponent's reply
causes.seen_misjudged: I saw it but misjudged it

tryStatus.same_as_game: Same move as in the game.
tryStatus.unverified: The engine could not check it.

review.doneHint: These positions are now in your daily repetition, both as 'find the punishment' and 'find the better move'.
review.notAnalysed: This game is still being analysed. Come back in a minute.

progress.metric: Pieces lost per 100 of your decisions
progress.paceTip: Tip: play 15+10 for a few weeks. Those games count for the analysis and give you time to run the blunder check on every move until it is automatic.
progress.descriptive: Descriptive only: it shows what changed, not what caused it.
